pull_request.body:
## Summary

First of three PRs for #331. The agents delivery funnels need a funnel that follows one issue (the `user_id` the GitHub events will carry) across days, so this adds a third funnel scope, `user`.

- A user funnel counts distinct `user_id_hash` values. Step N counts when it happens at or after step N-1 and within the conversion window of step 1. A user with several step-1 events counts at the furthest step any of them reaches.
- `conversion_window_seconds` is stored per funnel (migration 00040, nullable column) and defaults to 30 days. The service rejects a window on a session or page_view funnel, and any window that is not positive.
- Events without a user ID are left out of user funnels.
- An update that omits `scope` keeps the funnel's scope and window, so existing callers that only send name and steps change nothing.
- REST create/update, the MCP `create_funnel` / `update_funnel` tools and the funnel editor (a third "User" option plus a window in days) all accept the new fields.

## Testing

- Repository tests: ordering, the window, a restart after an expired step 1, equal timestamps, anonymous events, property filters and the default window.
- Service test for the validation and the keep-on-update behaviour.
- New API goldens for creating, analysing and deleting a user funnel, plus a 422 for a window on a session funnel. Existing goldens are unchanged.
- Vitest for the toggle and both modals.
- `go test ./...`, `make lint`, `make build`, `make regress`, tsc, eslint and vitest all pass locally.

Part of #331
pull_request.title: feat: user-scoped funnels with a conversion window (#331 PR A)
